name: Canri Native Language Model Package
capabilities: train a small causal Transformer from random initialization
build a hybrid word and lossless UTF-8 byte-fallback tokenizer from clean CANRI data
stream JSON, JSONL, and SQLite training sources without duplicating them
generate text without a cloud API
train assistant completions with prompt-masked loss
keep deterministic training and validation partitions separate
run a generation benchmark before activation
map inherited embeddings by token identity across tokenizer versions
transfer compatible weights into a ten-head 500-token-context architecture
assist specialist brains without replacing their authoritative result
account for LLM context and report volume separately from deterministic LFM brains
constrain byte-token decoding to complete valid UTF-8 sequences
select curriculum sources from measured held-out loss
block activation until sealed semantic and executable-code gates pass
acceptance_checks: The model starts from random weights
No cloud API or downloaded model is used
Training can be resumed from a checkpoint
Inference reports clearly when the model is untrained or unavailable
User-facing native output remains blocked until sealed and manual gates pass
Readiness requires held-out evaluation and explicit manual approval
